title: Constant modules over the constant ring sheaf on a small site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring. The constant module functor sends a $\Lambda$-module $M$ to a sheaf of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] over the constant ring sheaf $\underline\Lambda$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Explicitly first form the constant module presheaf with value $M$, over the constant ring presheaf with value $\Lambda$, with identity restriction maps; on linear maps use the same component at every object. Then apply module sheafification along the constant ring presheaf sheafification map [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. The resulting underlying abelian sheaf is the sheafification of the constant abelian presheaf of $M$, and the action is the unique extension of the constant presheaf scalar action.
